breaks.why: The reader gets no bridge between trying a line on customers and being confident, so they must guess what changed.

breaks.quote: the December meeting, in his own voice
breaks.why: The reader is never told what this meeting is or why it matters, a leap that only the shared context of the call would cover.

breaks.quote: He tried out his opening line on his morning customers.
breaks.why: The reader is never shown the opening line or how the customers reacted, so the moment has no content to carry.
